_source: Stock Unlimited, final class (the longer 'Lecture 6' recording, 1:36 h). Edit numbers here, not in code.

divergence._rule: RSI divergence (tops): price makes a higher high but RSI a lower high -> no strength, can fall. Positive divergence (lows): price higher low, RSI lower low -> up. Negative divergence (highs): price lower high, RSI higher high -> down. Works 7-8 of 10, not every time (1:03:24-1:10:13).

expiry_straddle._rule: At the open of the Nifty monthly-expiry day (on futures) buy a NEXT-week long straddle/strangle ~50 pts OTM each side; target = futures +-300 from that open, exit both together. Bank Nifty +-600 (now monthly only - not worth it). Best when India VIX is low (11-12); with high VIX (15-16) skip or wait 15 min. Skip the October week (holiday). He says it failed only once in several years (1:14:28-1:26:19).

red_expiry_btst._rule: A student's rule he said he would check: monthly expiry day closes red -> buy an OTM call at the close (BTST); next day it often gaps up / runs (1:26:29-1:31:21).
